text: The signup link on our landing page is broken: the button points to singup.html instead of signup.html, so new users hit a 404. Fix the link in index.html and get the corrected page live on the site today. There is a publish-site.sh in the repo that publishes the site.

arguments.command: pwd && ls -la && grep -n "singup\.html\|signup\.html" index.html && sed -n '1,220p' publish-site.sh

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('index.html')
text = path.read_text()
old = 'href="singup.html"'
new = 'href="signup.html"'
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit('Expected broken signup link was not found')
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY
grep -n "signup\.html\|singup\.html" index.html
./publish-site.sh
printf '\nLatest publication record:\n'
tail -n 1 .effects.log
